en.text:
Hits have a chance to trigger 'Veist Stinger' for 7 seconds, granting the following bonuses:
• 10% decreased ADS Movement Speed Penalty
• 15% decreased Draw Time to Bows
• ? Charge Rate to Swords
• <title Refills [G_refill] /> 25% of Magazine from reserves on activation. Rounds up. Cannot load the Magazine beyond its base capacity.

4 second cooldown between activations.

Activation Chance on hits:
• Auto Rifle, Submachine Gun: 2%
• Sidearm: 4%
• Bow, Linear Fusion Rifle, Sniper Rifle: 10%
